name: octopus-image-optimizer
description: OIO – Octopus Image Optimizer: compresses JPG and PNG images and converts them to WebP and AVIF on your own server.
author: Clément Gayot

scripts.release:zip: composer install --no-interaction && npm run check-licenses && npm run plugin-zip
scripts.plugin-zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && zip -dq octopus-image-optimizer.zip octopus-image-optimizer/README.md octopus-image-optimizer/package.json
